seoTitle: Basket Size — Meaning, Formula and Example
metaDescription: Basket size is the average number of items per bill. Basket size explains movements in order value. How many items an average customer buys in one visit.
definition: Basket size is the average number of items per bill. It sits alongside average order value: one measures how much a customer spends, the other how many things they buy.
bodyHtml:
Why Basket Size matters

Basket size explains movements in order value. A rising AOV from price increases is a very different signal from one driven by customers buying more items.

Basket Size formula

Basket size = Total items sold ÷ Number of bills

Read alongside AOV to separate price effects from volume effects.

How Basket Size works in practice

Track both together. If basket size is flat while AOV rises, growth is coming from price, which has a ceiling that item count does not.

faq.question: How do I increase basket size?
faq.answer: Placement, bundles and cross-sell prompts at the point of decision.

faq.question: Which matters more, basket size or AOV?
faq.answer: AOV is the revenue outcome; basket size explains how you got there.
